issues.issue: The page doesn't say whether these grants are federal or state. The Statement of Activities (p2-3) shows operating grants 410,736 and capital grants 246,100 with no source. The same assumption is made in detail[6], detail[35] and detail[45]. Review is already flagged.

Economic development loan repayments (Economic Development Fund, p21). These are principal collections, not revenue in substance. 'other' with review is defensible, but they could also be treated as reimbursements or as a non-revenue inflow.
This function line may mix environment (cemetery, sanitation) with parks and recreation. Recording the dominant category is defensible, but the notes don't mention the mix as the rules require.
Street Fund intergovernmental revenue is almost certainly the highway allocation, but the page doesn't state it. Review is already flagged.
